entities.summary: Márcio de Sousa e Melo was a Brazilian Air Marshal. He was one of the military in the joint military board that ruled Brazil between the illness of Artur da Costa e Silva in August 1969 and the investiture ceremony of Emílio Garrastazu Médici in October of that same year.
